label: More such carries distinct-cause transfer
description: A distinct cause of r in x is more r than x, and whatever is more r than something is r, so it is in act in r. Any route using 'more such' at an arbitrary perfection together with c11369aa is committed to distinct-cause transfer; conversely transfer with the reception bundle suffices for 'more such'. Each premise is needed in a checked interpretation (omission models). Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
